purpose: jenscolt's body (the top shell) rebuilt as parameters, every visible detail (eye sockets and rings, front grille, panels, rear features, rim); outer form and wall thickness as separate parameters, so scale and wall change independently. His inside is not kept beyond the shell wall.
pass_criterion: the default fidelity gate passes, the sweep's variants are valid solids, and the judge scores ≥ 0.70 against the mesh
must_have: outer form and wall thickness separate parameters (wall as an inward offset of the skin)
every visible detail a named feature placed on the skin: eye sockets and rings, front grille, panel lines, rear features
must_not: build.py reads a mesh: the reference meshes are read only by the gates and the designer's probes
